name: Expectancy (EV) Grid
when_to_pick: Show where a strategy crosses from negative to positive EXPECTANCY across the win-rate × reward-to-risk (R:R) plane — a coloured grid where each cell is the expected value per $100 risked. Use it to prove that a high win rate alone is not enough: a 60% win rate at 0.5:1 R:R still loses money over time. The reader hovers any cell to read its exact EV. Theme-aware fills via window.cpTheme. Pick this when the takeaway is 'which win-rate × R:R combinations are actually profitable'; for a single trade's R:R ladder use risk_reward_visualizer. For the spread of outcomes from ONE edge over many simulated runs use monte_carlo_simulator; to watch trades open and close tick by tick use live_simulator_candlestick.
